title: Invalid quantity or price is rejected with no message
evidence: Driven: Add line with quantity 'abc' added nothing and showed no error, alert or aria message. Price '1,5' gives NaN and is dropped the same way; price empty gives 0 and is dropped. The inputs have no `required`, type, or error element (index.html:16-18).
failing_case: User types price '12,50' (comma) and presses Add line: the form appears to do nothing, with no cause or next step.
remediation: Show an inline, aria-describedby error beside the failing field stating the rule ('Quantity must be a whole number of 1 or more', 'Price must be a number above 0, e.g. 12.50') and move focus to it.

title: Send posts an empty invoice when no lines have been added
evidence: Driven: loading the page and clicking Send immediately issued POST /api/invoices with body '[]'. No check on lines.length before the call.
failing_case: Open the page, click Send invoice. An empty invoice (total 0.00) is submitted to the server.
remediation: Return early with a visible message ('Add at least one line') when lines is empty, and keep Send disabled until there is a line.

quote: const res = await fetch("/api/invoices", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(lines) });
title: Send and Void do not handle a failed network call; the user gets no message
evidence: Driven with Playwright: with the request aborted, clicking Send raised an uncaught 'Failed to fetch' page error and no alert appeared. The only failure path is `!res.ok`; `fetch` rejects on offline/DNS/abort and nothing catches it. The same holds for the void call at app.js:33.
failing_case: User goes offline (or the server drops the connection), clicks Send invoice. The promise rejects, no alert, no text change. The user cannot tell whether the invoice went out and may re-send or assume success.
remediation: Wrap both fetch calls in try/catch, show the same visible error as the !res.ok branch with the cause and a retry, and disable the button while the call is in flight.

title: Void does nothing and says nothing for the signed-in user
evidence: The hard-coded user has roles ["viewer","billing"] (app.js:2); canVoid requires "admin" (guards.js:11). Driven: clicking Void made no request, no alert, no change. The button is rendered enabled with no explanation (index.html:24).
failing_case: Signed-in user without the admin role clicks Void invoice: the click is silently swallowed, so the user believes it was voided or that the app is broken.
remediation: Hide or disable Void for users who cannot use it (with a stated reason), and when a call is refused show 'Only admins can void invoices'.

title: A sent invoice gives no confirmation and the lines are not cleared, so a duplicate send is easy
evidence: Traced: on res.ok the only effect is `sentCount += 1`, a variable never read or rendered anywhere (grep of all four files). `lines` is not cleared and render() is not called. The only duplicate guard is tooSoon(), a 1-second window (guards.js:21-26), and the button is never disabled during the await.
failing_case: Click Send; nothing visible changes. The user clicks again after 1.2 s (or while a slow request is still pending past 1 s) and the same lines are POSTed a second time, creating a duplicate invoice.
remediation: Disable the button during the request, show a success state (and clear or lock the lines) on res.ok, and send an idempotency key so the server drops repeats; remove the unused sentCount or display it.

quote: const total = lines.reduce((sum, l) => sum + l.qty * l.price, 0);
title: Invoice total is float arithmetic on unrounded prices inside render, so it can disagree with the lines shown
evidence: Driven: price 0.333 x 3 displays '3 × 0.33' while the total shows 1.00 (0.999 rounded), though 3 × 0.33 = 0.99. validQuantity/price checks accept any number of decimals (app.js:18-19), and the raw unrounded values are what gets POSTed (app.js:26). The money rule lives in the view function.
failing_case: Line shows 3 × 0.33 and the invoice total reads 1.00; a client adds the lines on the invoice and gets 0.99.
remediation: Reject or round prices to 2 decimals at entry, hold amounts as integer cents, and compute the total in one pure, tested function that render only displays.

title: A whitespace-only client passes `required` and is added as an empty, invisible line
evidence:
Driven: client ' ', qty 3, price 0.333 added `
  • : 3 × 0.33
    • `. `required` accepts spaces; the trimmed value is never rechecked before lines.push.
failing_case: Typing spaces in Client and pressing Add line puts a line with no client name (and an empty focusable link) into the invoice that is then sent.
remediation: After trim(), reject an empty client with an inline error before pushing.

title: A line cannot be removed or corrected once added, and the form is not reset
evidence: No remove/edit control exists in render() (app.js:7-9) or index.html; the inputs are not cleared after push, so the previous values stay in the form.
failing_case: User mistypes a price, adds the line, and has no way to remove it; Send posts the wrong invoice, and reloading is the only fix (and loses everything).
remediation: Add a Remove button per line (labelled with the client), clear the form and return focus to Client after a successful add.

title: Void is destructive, unconfirmed, and names no invoice
evidence: The request has no body or id, so it is unclear which invoice is voided; there is no confirm step or undo, no success feedback (the ok path does nothing), and the button sits directly beside Send with identical styling (index.html:23-24, styles.css:4).
failing_case: An admin mis-clicks Void next to Send: the POST fires at once with no confirmation, and nothing tells them it worked or what was voided.
remediation: Send the invoice id, ask for confirmation naming the invoice, show a success state, and style Void as a secondary/danger action separated from Send.

title: The admin-only rule is enforced only in the browser
evidence: The role check is the only gate visible in the payload; `user` is a plain object in client code (app.js:2) that any visitor can edit in the console, and the void request carries no credential or proof beyond the cookie. No server code is in the payload, so enforcement there cannot be confirmed.
failing_case: A viewer runs `user.roles.push('admin')` in devtools (or calls fetch('/api/invoices/void', {method:'POST'}) directly) and voids an invoice unless the server separately checks the role.

requirement.why: Comment at guards.js:9 says only admins may void; server enforcement is not shown.

remediation: Enforce the admin check in /api/invoices/void on the server from the authenticated session; keep canVoid only to hide the button.

title: Each line's client name is a link to '#' that does nothing, and the whole list is rebuilt inside a live region
evidence: The anchor has no handler or real target (grep: no click listener on #lines), so each line adds a dead tab stop that scrolls to top on activation; `title` duplicates the text. `ul` has aria-live=polite (index.html:21) and innerHTML is replaced wholesale, so a screen reader may re-announce every line on each add.
failing_case: Keyboard user tabs through N dead links; each Add line may re-read the entire list.
remediation: Render the client as plain text (no anchor, no title); announce only the added line through a separate status element.
